articles.headline: Trump says U.S. military strike killed leader of Tren de Aragua gang
articles.summary: President Trump said Friday that a U.S. strike has killed Hector Rusthenford Guerrero Flores, whom he called "the infamous leader" of the Tren de Aragua gang in Venezuela.
articles._summary: President Donald Trump is pictured during an event where he signs a proclamation about the fishing industry, in the Oval Office of the White House, Thursday, June 11, 2026, in Washington. Jacquelyn Martin/AP hide caption WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump said Friday that a "swift and lethal kinetic" U.S. strike has killed Hector Rusthenford Guerrero Flores, whom he called "the infamous leader" of the Tren de Aragua gang. Tren de Aragua has been labeled by the United States as a terrorist organization. Guerrero Flores was charged in a New York federal court with racketeering conspiracy and other crimes, including lending support to terrorists in crimes that stretched more than a decade, authorities announced in December. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth posted on X that the strike occurred earlier in the week on a Tren de Aragua compound in Venezuela.
articles._zh_headline: 特朗普称美国军事打击杀死了特伦·德·阿拉瓜帮派头目
articles._zh_summary: 照片中，唐纳德·特朗普总统于 2026 年 6 月 11 日星期四在华盛顿白宫椭圆形办公室举行的一次活动中签署了一项有关渔业的公告。杰奎琳·马丁/美联社隐藏标题华盛顿——唐纳德·特朗普总统周五表示，美国的一次“迅速而致命的”袭击杀死了赫克托·鲁斯滕福德·格雷罗·弗洛雷斯，他称他为特伦·德·阿拉瓜帮的“臭名昭著的头目”。特伦·德·阿拉瓜已被美国列为恐怖组织。当局去年 12 月宣布，格雷罗·弗洛雷斯 (Guerrero Flores) 在纽约联邦法院被指控犯有串谋敲诈勒索和其他罪行，其中包括为恐怖分子提供支持，犯罪时间长达十多年。国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯 (Pete Hegseth) 在 X 上发帖称，本周早些时候，委内瑞拉特伦德阿拉瓜 (Tren de Aragua) 的一处院落发生了袭击事件。

articles.headline: US And Iran Near Peace Pact As Pakistan Confirms Final Draft— JD Vance Slams 'Fake' Information On Terms: 'Iranians Are Not Receiving Any Cash...'
articles.summary: Proposed U.S.-Iran peace deal nears completion, tying sanctions relief to nuclear dismantlement, inspections and regional de-escalation.
articles._summary: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said Friday a “final, agreed upon text” of a U.S.-Iran peace deal has been reached, as Pakistan works with both sides to finalize next steps amid what Sharif called an “incessant misinformation campaign” by those seeking to sabotage the agreement. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi posted on X earlier Friday, before Sharif’s statement, that a deal “has never been closer.” Vice President JD Vance addressed the misinformation directly on X, writing that “the Iranians are not receiving any cash, and no funds are being released for simply signing a deal or attending a meeting,” adding that economic benefits would flow to Iran and the region only if Tehran meets its obligations. articles._zh_headline: 随着巴基斯坦确认最终草案，美国和伊朗接近达成和平协议——JD万斯猛烈抨击有关条款的“虚假”信息：“伊朗人没有收到任何现金……”
articles._zh_summary: 巴基斯坦总理谢赫巴兹·谢里夫周五表示，美伊和平协议的“最终商定文本”已经达成，巴基斯坦正在与双方合作，在谢里夫所说的那些试图破坏协议的人“不断的虚假信息活动”中敲定下一步行动。周五早些时候，在谢里夫发表声明之前，伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇 (Abbas Araghchi) 在 X 上发帖表示，达成协议“从未如此接近”。副总统 JD 万斯直接在 X 上回应了错误信息，他写道，“伊朗人没有收到任何现金，也没有因为签署协议或参加会议而释放任何资金”，并补充说，只有德黑兰履行其义务，经济利益才会流向伊朗和该地区。免责声明：该内容部分是在人工智能工具的帮助下制作的，并由 Benzinga 编辑审阅和发布。

articles.headline: Justice Dept. approves Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery
articles.summary: The decision paves the way for a proposed $111 billion merger uniting two rival studio giants — Paramount, owner of CBS, and the much larger Warner, which includes HBO and CNN.
articles._summary: The main gate to Paramount Studios is seen on Melrose Avenue, July 8, 2015, in Los Angeles. Nick Ut/AP hide caption The Justice Department on Friday approved Paramount's proposed $111 billion takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery. After concluding its antitrust investigation into the pending merger, the department said in a statement that it found that the deal posed no threat to competition or consumers of film, broadcast television or streaming. The decision clears the way for a merger of two rival Hollywood studio titans: Paramount, the owner of CBS, including CBS News, will swallow the much larger Warner, which includes HBO and CNN. The DOJ''s Antitrust Division concluded that a union of two studio giants isn't anti-competitive because the streaming market has expanded the competition for conventional Hollywood studios, which includes Netflix, Apple and Amazon, as well as smaller streamers.
articles._zh_headline: 司法部批准派拉蒙收购华纳兄弟探索公司
articles._zh_summary: 2015 年 7 月 8 日，洛杉矶梅尔罗斯大道上看到派拉蒙影城的正门。 Nick Ut/美联社 隐藏标题 司法部周五批准了派拉蒙以 1,110 亿美元收购华纳兄弟探索公司的提议。在结束对即将进行的合并的反垄断调查后，该部门在一份声明中表示，发现该交易不会对电影、广播电视或流媒体的竞争或消费者构成威胁。这一决定为两家竞争对手的好莱坞制片巨头的合并扫清了道路：哥伦比亚广播公司（包括哥伦比亚广播公司新闻）的所有者派拉蒙将吞并规模大得多的华纳，其中包括 HBO 和 CNN。美国司法部反垄断部门得出的结论是，两家电影公司巨头的联盟并不反竞争，因为流媒体市场扩大了传统好莱坞电影公司（包括 Netflix、苹果和亚马逊）以及规模较小的流媒体公司的竞争。

articles._summary: VanEck Semiconductor ETF (NASDAQ: SMH ) has outperformed the market over the past 15 years by 15.05% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 27.5%.
